external_entities.name: members
external_entities.description: People who use the loyalty programme, collect points, spend points on gift cards, and connect partner apps.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Members collect points when they shop and spend them on gift cards.

external_entities.name: members' phones
external_entities.description: Phones on which the mobile app and its refresh tokens run.
external_entities.source_excerpt: The app keeps a refresh token on the phone.

external_entities.name: browser
external_entities.description: A member's browser used to sign in, approve consent, and return an authorization code.
external_entities.source_excerpt: The browser then returns to the partner app's redirect URI with an authorization code.

external_entities.name: other companies
external_entities.description: Companies that run partner apps on their own servers.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Partner apps are web applications that other companies run on their own servers

processes.name: mobile app
processes.description: Mobile application used by members to sign in, call the rewards API, and disconnect partner apps.
processes.notes: Nobody wrote down whether the app sends a PKCE challenge.

processes.name: authorization server
processes.description: Authorization service handling sign-in, authorization codes, tokens, scopes, and partner consent.
processes.source_excerpt: The app signs a member in through our authorization server with the authorization code flow

processes.name: rewards API
processes.description: API that accepts access tokens and reads and writes the points ledger.
processes.source_excerpt: The rewards API reads and writes the points ledger

processes.name: partner app
processes.description: A web application run by another company, such as a meal-planning service that shows a member's points.
processes.source_excerpt: Partner apps are web applications that other companies run on their own servers

processes.name: support console
processes.description: Web application that closes a member's account.
processes.source_excerpt: The support console is a web app that closes a member's account.

processes.name: authorization server's sign-in page
processes.description: Sign-in page presented by the authorization server in a member's browser.
processes.source_excerpt: A member who connects a partner app signs in on the authorization server's sign-in page in their browser
processes.notes: This is the sign-in page of the authorization server.

data_stores.name: identity database
data_stores.description: Database containing member accounts, email addresses, password hashes, authorization codes, refresh tokens, consents, and account closure state.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The authorization server keeps member accounts, email addresses and password hashes in the identity database

data_stores.name: points ledger
data_stores.description: Ledger containing every member's balance and every points transaction, including the client that made each change.
data_stores.source_excerpt: the points ledger, which holds every member's balance and every points transaction

data_stores.name: API log store
data_stores.description: Store containing every request received by the rewards API, including headers.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The rewards API also writes every request it receives, headers included, to the API log store.

data_flows.name: use mobile app
data_flows.description: Members use the mobile app.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Members use our mobile app.
data_flows.data_description: Member loyalty activity and account interactions

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: The mobile app signs a member in through the authorization server using the authorization code flow.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app signs a member in through our authorization server with the authorization code flow
data_flows.notes: The source does not state whether the app sends a PKCE challenge.

data_flows.name: call rewards API
data_flows.description: The mobile app calls the rewards API with an access token.
data_flows.source_excerpt: then calls the rewards API with the access token it gets back.

data_flows.name: request token
data_flows.description: The partner app sends token requests containing its client secret in the request body.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The partner app sends that secret in the body of its token requests.
data_flows.data_description: Token request containing a client secret

data_flows.name: sign-in and consent
data_flows.description: The member uses the authorization server's sign-in page and approves the listed scopes.
data_flows.source_excerpt: A member who connects a partner app signs in on the authorization server's sign-in page in their browser and approves a consent screen that lists the scopes.

data_flows.name: return authorization code
data_flows.description: The authorization server returns an authorization code through the partner app's redirect URI.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The browser then returns to the partner app's redirect URI with an authorization code.
data_flows.notes: The source describes the browser-mediated return; the authorization server is the issuer of the authorization code.

data_flows.name: close account
data_flows.description: A member uses the support console to close an account.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The support console is a web app that closes a member's account.
data_flows.notes: The text does not explicitly state that members use the support console; this flow represents the console interaction described by its account-closing behavior.

data_flows.name: obtain access token
data_flows.description: The support console obtains access tokens from the authorization server.
data_flows.source_excerpt: It takes access tokens from the same authorization server

data_flows.name: close account record
data_flows.description: The support console marks a member's account closed in the identity database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Closing an account marks it closed in the identity database.
data_flows.notes: The connection protocol is not recorded.

data_flows.name: disconnect partner app
data_flows.description: The mobile app requests disconnection of a partner app and deletion of its refresh token.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Members can disconnect a partner app from the settings screen of the mobile app, which deletes that app's refresh token from the identity database.
data_flows.data_description: Partner disconnection request and refresh-token deletion

data_flows.name: issue access token
data_flows.description: The authorization server provides the mobile app with an access token.
data_flows.source_excerpt: then calls the rewards API with the access token it gets back.

data_flows.name: read and write points
data_flows.description: The rewards API reads and writes the points ledger.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The rewards API reads and writes the points ledger
data_flows.notes: The connection protocol is not recorded.

data_flows.name: write request logs
data_flows.description: The rewards API writes each received request, including headers, to the API log store.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The rewards API also writes every request it receives, headers included, to the API log store.
data_flows.notes: The connection protocol is not recorded.

data_flows.name: close account request
data_flows.description: The support console is served on the same public hostname as the rewards API and can submit its account-closing request.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The support console is a web app that closes a member's account.
data_flows.notes: The source states the shared public hostname but does not explicitly describe a support-console-to-rewards-API request.

trust_boundaries.name: our cloud account
trust_boundaries.description: The organisation's cloud account where the described system components run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Everything below runs in our own cloud account

trust_boundaries.name: members' phones
trust_boundaries.description: Members' phones, outside the organisation's cloud account.

trust_boundaries.name: partner apps' own servers
trust_boundaries.description: Servers owned or operated by other companies that run partner apps.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Partner apps are web applications that other companies run on their own servers

assumptions.assumption: The support console is reachable from the internet because it is served on the same public hostname as the rewards API.
assumptions.basis: The text says the support console is served on the same public hostname as the rewards API.

assumptions.assumption: The identity database contains confidential data because it stores member personal information, password hashes, authorization codes, refresh tokens, and consents.
assumptions.basis: The stated contents include email addresses, password hashes, authorization codes, refresh tokens, and consents.

assumptions.assumption: The points ledger contains confidential data because it stores member balances and points transactions.
assumptions.basis: The stated contents include every member's balance and every points transaction.

assumptions.assumption: The API log store contains confidential data because request headers can contain credentials and requests can contain member-related data.
assumptions.basis: The store contains every request received by the rewards API, headers included.
